nfl.oneThing: Texans defensive end Chris Braswell was carted off with a serious-looking right knee injury on the opening kickoff of Thursday night's game against the Colts, and Houston ruled him out straight away.

headlines.title: Braswell carted off on the opening kickoff
headlines.summary: Texans defensive end Chris Braswell hurt his right knee on the opening kickoff of Thursday night's game against the Colts. He was blocked by Caden Curry while Seth McGowan returned the ball, and he left the field on a cart with an air cast covering the leg. Houston ruled him out immediately. It was his first game of the season after being elevated from the practice squad. He had played all 34 games in his first two seasons after being a second-round pick of Tampa Bay in 2024.
headlines.whyItMatters: Houston are 3-6 and 11th in the AFC, and the Colts are 3-7. Every injury now matters for a team trying to climb back into the race.

headlines.title: Jets' offence goes nine quarters without a touchdown
headlines.summary: The Jets have not scored a touchdown since their Nov. 1 loss to the Raiders in Las Vegas. Since then they have been held to field goals from Jason Sanders. Offensive coordinator Frank Reich took the blame on Thursday. 'It starts with me,' he said. 'It's been nine quarters. Believe me, I feel every play of that nine quarters.' Reich said the team needs more points in the red zone and from further out.
headlines.whyItMatters: New York are 2-8, on a five-game losing streak, and 13th in the AFC. The offence is the main problem, and the coaching staff is accepting responsibility for it.

headlines.title: Eagles' seven-game skid meets the Steelers
headlines.summary: The Eagles are 2-7 and have lost seven straight. The Steelers have not won in Philadelphia since 1965, according to ESPN. Pittsburgh are 6-3 and sixth in the AFC. Philadelphia are also without WR Dontayvion Wicks, who has been out since Week 6 and is limited in practice.
headlines.whyItMatters: Philadelphia are 16th in the NFC and the losing streak is the story of their season. For Pittsburgh, this is a chance to keep their winning run going against a struggling side.

teamNews.title: Brock Bowers progressing towards Week 11
teamNews.text: Brock Bowers was a limited participant at Thursday's practice and is listed as questionable for the game at Denver. ESPN's Ryan McFadden reports he is progressing well and could be good to go, after being seen in full pads and warming up. Bowers has been averaging 5.2 catches over the last five games, down from 6.3 for the season.

teamNews.title: Mendoza's first road start is at Denver
teamNews.text: Fernando Mendoza makes his first career road start at Denver, where the Broncos (7-2) have won five straight. He was sacked half a dozen times by Seattle in his first start, and he and Klint Kubiak both took the blame after the 21–13 loss. Kurt Warner said Mendoza played 'too fast' in his NFL debut.

contextCard.title: How NFL tiebreakers work
contextCard.body: When two teams finish with the same record, head-to-head results come first. If that doesn't split them, the next step is record within the division, then record against common opponents. Tiebreakers matter most in the back half of the season, when the playoff race gets tight.

headlines.title: Jazz stun the Lakers
headlines.summary: Keyonte George had 30 points, 10 assists and five threes as Utah beat the Lakers 109–97. Utah had been 2-13 before the game. Luka Doncic scored 29 with seven assists, but Austin Reaves was out with a left heel bruise. Doncic is averaging 38.1 points a game, the best in the league. Ace Bailey added 19 points and eight rebounds for Utah.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Lakers still lead the West at 13-3, but a 3-13 team beating them is a warning sign. Utah are 14th in the West.

headlines.title: Bucks lose 11th straight as Heat win
headlines.summary: The Heat beat the Bucks 137–130. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists for Miami. Kyle Kuzma scored 26 for Milwaukee, who are 1-14 after losing 11 straight. The Bucks have lost all 10 of their most recent games, and Myles Turner is out with a left shoulder bruise.
headlines.whyItMatters: Milwaukee are 15th in the East and have the worst record in the East. Miami are fourth at 9-6 and have won six straight.

headlines.title: Randle blasts Nets' effort after Bulls blowout
headlines.summary: The Bulls beat the Nets 137–107. Julius Randle said his teammates showed 'no pride', calling it 'one of the worst games I've ever been a part of'. Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists for Chicago, and Matas Buzelis scored 25. The loss was Brooklyn's third straight and left them 3-11.
headlines.whyItMatters: Brooklyn are 14th in the East. RealGM notes the new lottery rules could make a bottom-three finish more useful to the Nets.

headlines.title: Edwards has no timeline for knee return
headlines.summary: Anthony Edwards says he plans to come back from right knee arthroscopic surgery but does not know when. He spoke publicly for the first time since the procedure. 'Whenever my knee tells me it's ready, then I'll be ready,' he said. Yahoo Sports reports he is set to miss multiple months. The Timberwolves have not announced a timeline.

headlines.title: Raptors lose RJ Barrett to hamstring strain
headlines.summary: RJ Barrett has a mild right hamstring strain and will be out for at least two weeks, with a re-evaluation then. Collin Murray-Boyles was placed in concussion protocol. Barrett is averaging 20.9 points, 6.4 rebounds and 4.3 assists. Toronto are already without Kawhi Leonard, and they have lost six straight.
headlines.whyItMatters: Toronto are 5-10 and ninth in the East. With Leonard and Barrett both out, the wing rotation is thin.

teamNews.title: Dylan Harper out with hip strain
teamNews.text: Dylan Harper has a left hip rotator strain and has avoided a major injury, according to ESPN's Shams Charania. The one-to-three-week timetable depends on his rehab. Coach Mitch Johnson said the Spurs are 'very lucky, fortunate and mostly just happy' the injury was not worse. Harper is averaging 18.3 points and 5.5 rebounds.
